quotes.quote: The world isn't perfect. But it's there for us, doing the best it can. That's what makes it so damn beautiful.
People's lives don't end when they die. It ends when they lose faith.
If you don't take risks, you can't create a future.
The moment you think of giving up, think of the reason why you held on so long.
I'll leave tomorrow's problems to tomorrow's me.
Being weak is nothing to be ashamed of. Staying weak is.
Fear is not evil. It tells you what your weakness is. And once you know your weakness, you can become stronger.
Even if I die, you keep living okay? Live to see the end of this world, and to see why it was born. Live to see why a weak girl like me ended up here... And the reason why you and I met.

I am not alone. I can hear them... I can hear everyone's voices... I can sense everyone's feelings... I am not alone... Everyone's feelings... They support me... They are what gives me the will to stand and fight!
We are all like fireworks. We climb, shine, and always go our separate ways and become further apart. But even if that time comes, let's not disappear like a firework, and continue to shine forever.
The only ones who should kill are those prepared to be killed.
Knowing what it feels to be in pain is exactly why we try to be kind to others.
It's not about whether I can. I have to do it. I'm a hero, and heroes save people.
No matter how deep the night, it always turns to day, eventually.
I want you to be happy. I want you to laugh a lot. I don't know what exactly I'll be able to do for you, but I'll always be by your side.
A lesson without pain is meaningless. That's because no one can gain without sacrificing something. But by enduring that pain and overcoming it, he shall obtain a powerful, unmatched heart.
Giving up kills people. When people reject giving up, they finally win the right to transcend humanity.
Whatever you lose, you'll find it again. But what you throw away you'll never get back.
Life is not a game of luck. If you wanna win, work hard.
I refuse to let my fear control me anymore. I will fight. I will protect. I will become strong enough to never lose anyone again.
